turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, Hale, and on what basis? I have a call at 4:40.
Can I ask something off the record?
There is no off the record, Hale. Everything said in this room goes in my notes. Who decided on the zero?
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned here, Hale. You entered a zero before anyone called me. On what basis?
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.

I'm writing that down, word for word: "kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice." My son doesn't cheat, Hale, and you've just told his mother she's the reason he does. Show me a document or I'm going to the principal's office.
